[[File:Blue Dog Coalition in the 117th United States Congress.svg|alt=|thumb|[[Blue Dog Coalition]] in the [[117th United States Congress]]]]
This is a '''List of members of the [[Blue Dog Coalition]]'''.

The co-chairs of the Blue Dog Coalition for the [[117th United States Congress|117th Congress]] are [[Ed Case]] (HI-01), [[Stephanie Murphy]] (FL-07), and [[Tom O'Halleran]] (AZ-01).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Members|url=https://bluedogcaucus-costa.house.gov/members|access-date=2021-05-08|website=Blue Dog Coalition|language=en}}</ref> The chair of the Blue Dog PAC, the Coalition's political organization, is Rep. [[Kurt Schrader]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rollcall.com/news/politics/blue-dog-coalition-elects-3-new-co-chairs-lead-next-congress|title=Blue Dog Coalition Elects 3 New Co-Chairs to Lead Them in Next Congress|first1=Lindsey|last1=McPherson|date=November 28, 2018|website=rollcall.com}}</ref> Rep. Murphy, a Vietnamese-American, is the first woman of color to lead the Blue Dog Coalition in its history.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thebeatdc.com/blog/2018/11/28/blue-dog-coalition-elects-first-woman-of-color-as-co-chair|title=The Beat: BLUE DOG COALITION ELECTS FIRST WOMAN OF COLOR AS CO-CHAIR|last=|first=|date=2018|website=|access-date=}}</ref>

As of January 2021, the caucus includes 19 members.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bluedogcaucus-costa.house.gov/members|title=Blue Dog Coalition}}</ref>

==2018 elections==
After the [[United States House of Representatives elections, 2018|2018 House of Representatives elections]], the caucus grew from 18 members to 24 members, registering an increment in membership of little more than 33%.<ref name="mcclatchydc.com">{{cite web|url=https://www.mcclatchydc.com/news/politics-government/congress/article224896090.html|title=Shutdown, health care, budget: How moderate House Democrats will influence the party|website=mcclatchydc}}</ref> All incumbents seeking re-election won their races.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.rollcall.com/news/politics/progressive-caucus-new-dems-blue-dogs-prepare-growth|title=House Democratic Factions All See Gains After Midterms|date=November 13, 2018|work=Roll Call}}</ref>
